# Full-Scope Requirements Quality Checklist: Render UX & Output Routing

**Purpose**: Rigorous reviewer-owned evaluation of specification quality, completeness, and edge-case coverage across UI layout, media preview, output routing, adaptive estimation, and logging.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Viewport Layout & Sticky Controls Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are fixed header dimensions and sticky control behavior explicitly defined for viewports under 768px height? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the table container's internal vertical scrolling behavior specified without creating double scrollbars? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are button state transitions (Start, Stop, Reload) in the header consistently specified between idle, active, and finished batch states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are column width constraints and horizontal overflow rules defined for all 4 queue table columns? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Active Render Auto-Scroll & Progress Timeline Quality

- [ ] CHK005 Is the trigger mechanism and scroll offset for auto-scrolling the active row to the top explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Are timeline auto-expansion requirements defined when navigating between consecutively rendered videos? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Spec §User Story 1.2]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the spec specify whether previously completed rows remain expanded or collapse automatically? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Are visual state indicators (pending, active, completed, failed) consistently defined for all 6 stages within the expanded accordion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]

## Integer Timers, Interpolation & Adaptive Re-Estimation Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Is the integer second formatting rule (`Xs` vs `Xm Ys`) consistently specified across individual rows, tooltip badges, and the overall queue summary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Are progress bar plateau ceilings explicitly defined for each of the 6 stages when execution exceeds predicted duration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the mechanism for preventing the progress bar from reaching 100% before Stage 6 completion unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Are dynamic re-estimation requirements defined for all remaining pending items immediately after a video completes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §User Story 2.3]
- [ ] CHK013 Can the dynamic re-estimation behavior be objectively verified without inspecting server internals? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-005]

## Output Directory Routing & Classification Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Are unambiguous classification rules documented for routing videos to `outputs/` versus `outputs-no-lyrics/`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Are visual badge requirements (labels, colors, positions) specified for distinguishing "Có lyrics" and "Không lời" outputs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the spec define database schema requirements (`has_lyrics`, `output_folder`) in `videos_db.json` for both output categories? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK017 Are download and streaming route requirements specified for files located in `outputs-no-lyrics/`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Assumptions]

## Media Preview Lightbox & Terminal Logging Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are interaction requirements defined for opening the lightbox modal from both source image thumbnails and finished video players? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Are dismiss triggers (close button, dark backdrop click, `Esc` key) explicitly specified for the media preview modal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK020 Are console log formatting rules (emoji markers, stage numbering, single-line constraint) specified for all 6 pipeline stages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK021 Can the 60% terminal log reduction success criterion be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
